attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Changes behavior of QueryString/Header/Form access in Liquid templates from string[] to a StringValues wrapper whose equality, string conversion (joins without separator), and single-value unwrapping semantics differ from the old ArrayValue, which could subtly break existing templates that compare or manipulate these values across many sites/tenants."}

reason: Changes behavior of QueryString/Header/Form access in Liquid templates from string[] to a StringValues wrapper whose equality, string conversion (joins without separator), and single-value unwrapping semantics differ from the old ArrayValue, which could subtly break existing templates that compare or manipulate these values across many sites/tenants.
